newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas wins Chile flight rights.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas wins Chile flight rights.

text.p: Australian authorities said on Tuesday Qantas Airways Ltd had been granted the rights for two services a week to Chile.

Qantas planned to use the rights, for Boeing 767-300s or equivalent capacity, in a code-sharing service with Chile's Linea Area de Chile SA, Australia's International Air Services Commission said in a statement.
The services are due to begin from April 1, with Qantas the operating carrier between Australia and French Polynesia and LAN Chile between French Polynesia and Chile, the commission said.
The commission, in charge of allocating Australia's international flight capacity, also renewed Qantas' allocation of 21.8 B747 units of capacity weekly between Australia and Thailand.

It also issued a draft determination renewing Qantas' allocations on the United States route and a final determination confirming the renewal of unlimited capacity between Australia and New Zealand to Ansett Airlines Ltd.
